description: #1392/#1393/#1394: FEEL type errors are suppressed failures (null), not incidents. The input mapping `x + 1` with a string `x` maps y = null and the job is created (no IO_MAPPING_ERROR); the gateway condition takes the else branch of a non-boolean `if` condition, where cross-type `=`, `+` and unary `-` all yield null, so the conditioned flow is taken, not the default.
